note: Acceptance scenarios, not an executed browser test report. Qt observations cover only named probe steps.

cases.name: Control provenance
cases.given: A candidate web UI adds or renames a control
cases.when: Compare control inventory with the frozen desktop rules and captures
cases.then: Each control has a desktop counterpart or an explicit approved adaptation; unknowns are not implemented from guesses

cases.name: Draft survives live application renders
cases.given: Deferred numeric field at 10.25; another control can trigger re-renders
cases.when: Type 12., place caret before decimal, trigger unrelated store notifications, then Enter
cases.then: Draft and caret remain stable; committed value stays 10.25 until Enter, then 12

cases.name: Invalid draft and local text undo
cases.given: Deferred field at 10.25
cases.when: Try incomplete -, commit; type 22 and use Ctrl+Z
cases.then: Invalid commit restores 10.25; Ctrl+Z undoes text without touching scene history

cases.name: Contextual typed Escape
cases.given: Non-dialog numeric field at 10.25, no scrub active
cases.when: Type 14.75, press Escape, then focus another control
cases.then: Match captured Qt draft/commit behavior; do not apply scrub cancellation to ordinary typed draft

cases.name: Precise unchanged imperial readout
cases.given: Stored dimension has more precision than its visible decimal readout
cases.when: Focus and commit unchanged text
cases.then: Original model value retained; no rounded-value geometry edit

cases.name: Focused scrub and Alt continuity
cases.given: Numeric input already focused
cases.when: Scrub right beyond threshold, hold Alt without moving, move further, release Alt without moving, reverse, cancel
cases.then: Scrub works while focused; modifier transitions alone never jump; cancellation restores precise start

cases.name: Wheel ownership
cases.given: Unfocused .5-step numeric field at 12.5 over a scrollable sidebar
cases.when: Send one positive wheel notch over field
cases.then: Field becomes 13 with no focus requirement; canvas does not zoom as a second consequence

cases.name: Popup highlight and value
cases.given: Combo with Alpha/Beta/Gamma, Beta selected
cases.when: Closed Down; open Up; Escape; reopen and accept highlighted item
cases.then: Closed Down commits Gamma; popup Up only highlights Beta; Escape leaves Gamma; acceptance commits highlight

cases.name: Dropdown layout and resize
cases.given: Long item/icon list with selected item near end; field at viewport edges
cases.when: Open, resize/scroll parent, change font size; reopen
cases.then: Longest text fits arrow area; left field anchoring, top scroll and above/below clamping follow DROP-01

cases.name: Editable print density
cases.given: PNG Architectural PPI editable combo
cases.when: Select preset; type a valid non-preset; try invalid intermediate text; commit
cases.then: Preset and typed workflows retained with field range/commit semantics; no browser-only validation popup

cases.name: Selector versus amount
cases.given: Wall preset, measurement-mode selector, effect strength and Angle controls
cases.when: Compare at minimum, midpoint, maximum, disabled
cases.then: Discrete/directional controls have no amount fill; amount fill uses true min/max; vertical selector orientation and labels match

cases.name: Slider keyboard increments
cases.given: 0..100 slider at 50, single step 1/page 10
cases.when: Right, PageUp, Home, End
cases.then: Values 51,61,0,100; no canvas nudge or page scroll

cases.name: Pointer capture and commit once
cases.given: Active object/field/slider drag
cases.when: Leave control, release outside, then receive lostpointercapture
cases.then: Release goes to active gesture; exactly one commit; ordinary lost capture after commit does not undo it

cases.name: Chorded right cancellation
cases.given: Left-button object translation active
cases.when: Press right while left remains down, including pointermove button-change delivery
cases.then: Gesture cancels and geometry restores; no accidental context action or committed duplicate

cases.name: Real-coordinate picker rearm
cases.given: Armed picker with captured RGB or SV drag
cases.when: Drag outside; release outside; move outside; reenter; leave without buttons
cases.then: Match color-popup-traces.json; captured target/bubbled move outside does not count as reentry

cases.name: Picker consumes outside dismissal
cases.given: Picker open over canvas or another actionable control
cases.when: Click outside once
cases.then: Picker accepts; same press/release/click does not begin underlying geometry action

cases.name: Portal theme and stacking
cases.given: Dark and light themes; picker opened from an editor overlay/dialog
cases.when: Open near all edges; scroll/resize; operate picker; dismiss
cases.then: Correct theme variables, visible bounds and modal-layer ownership; click remains in intended overlay

cases.name: Submenu chain travel
cases.given: Context submenu parent and child
cases.when: Hover parent; travel into child; move elsewhere in root; reopen; click parent; click outside
cases.then: Match MENU-01; no click-toggle close after hover-open, stale highlight or detached child

cases.name: Keyboard context boundaries
cases.given: Canvas selection plus focused text field/control; Export has pending numeric edit
cases.when: Ctrl+A/Z/V, arrows, Tab in each context; Export Ctrl+Z while text pending
cases.then: Text/control keys stay local; Canvas Tab toggles orientation; export commits pending text then routes export history

cases.name: Tab-bar keyboard activation
cases.given: Three tabs, first active
cases.when: Focus bar; Right; move to last and Right again
cases.then: Second activates immediately; last remains last; no second action via keyup/synthetic click

cases.name: IME and shortcut repetition
cases.given: Composing text in editor; one-shot toggle shortcut available
cases.when: Press composition Enter; hold toggle; try Save through supported host shortcut
cases.then: Composition not submitted as command; one-shot actions do not oscillate; unavailable host shortcuts have reachable menu equivalent

cases.name: Modeless Enter and modal defaults
cases.given: Settings numeric field plus unsaved/replacement prompts
cases.when: Commit .37 with Enter; interact with canvas behind Settings; open prompts and press default/Escape
cases.then: Settings stays open and modeless; prompt defaults and cancellation match actual per-dialog policy

cases.name: Tree hit regions and mixed state
cases.given: Partially checked visibility row
cases.when: Click caption, then checkbox; use Space on focused checkable item
cases.then: Caption does not toggle; mixed checkbox becomes unchecked; cursor and keyboard match

cases.name: Disabled means inactive
cases.given: Disabled dependency group/reset plus enabled parent heading
cases.when: Pointer/keyboard activation attempts, then enable group
cases.then: Labels/controls use disabled appearance; no callbacks or hand cursor; enabling restores behavior without stuck drag

cases.name: Outer metrics and state palettes
cases.given: Bundled fonts loaded, dark/light UI and independently varied canvas theme
cases.when: Measure palette button, field arrow area, tabs/headings; idle/hover/pressed/checked/disabled/focus
cases.then: Use outer reference bounds, correct actual fonts and each semantic role; no native decoration or border-box size drift

cases.name: Small viewport and nested scroll
cases.given: 1280x720 and smaller browser content region; narrow sidebar, long names, expanded sections
cases.when: Resize container, scroll nested panels, collapse/restore properties, enter/leave Export
cases.then: Pinned action reachable; no clipped labels; intended scroll container owns wheel; split sizes restore

cases.name: Wheel devices and scale spaces
cases.given: Equivalent pixel/line/page wheel inputs, fractional DPR, active wheel-consuming placement
cases.when: Wheel over canvas and controls; change browser zoom/monitor DPR
cases.then: Equivalent normalized gesture results; no multiple discrete selection increments from tiny trackpad events; hit targets stay logical size

cases.name: Rerender and stale preview lifetime
cases.given: Active resize/rotation/pivot drag or pending export render
cases.when: Cause unrelated React render and rapid format/scale change; complete older async image last
cases.then: Gesture state stays stable; no duplicate listeners/history; only current preview appears

cases.name: Renderer semantics
cases.given: Rounded SVG furniture with theme text, transparent overlaps and outlined export text
cases.when: Compare drawing and PNG/SVG at several scales, rotations and nonuniform sizes
cases.then: Rounded corners, clip/fill rules, text anchors and line weights preserve specified behavior

cases.name: Tooltip parity and hover cleanup
cases.given: Themed control with tooltip, popup parent and disabled variant
cases.when: Hover, leave, open/dismiss popup and hover near viewport edge
cases.then: Exact transient text and ownership retained; no extra permanent paragraph or stale parent highlight; tooltip timing/appearance measured rather than assumed from HTML title

cases.name: Bounded arithmetic entry
cases.given: Decimal, integer, imperial, live-preview and mixed editors
cases.when: Commit arithmetic, relative shorthand, malformed expressions and code-like input
cases.then: Respect units, precision, bounds, deferred expression commits and parser limits without executing code

cases.name: SVG paint and occlusion parity
cases.given: Styled furnishings, materials and overlapping geometry
cases.when: Recolor selected roles, consolidate equivalent layers and switch solid objects
cases.then: Preserve fills, occlusion, normalized text/dashes and seamless material coverage while avoiding unrelated rebuilds

cases.name: Free angle editing and rendering
cases.given: An AngleGuide with two arms and a middle point
cases.when: Edit angle, drag each point with Ctrl/global/local modes and inspect hover/right angles
cases.then: Preserve point identities, translate arms with middle, use exact geometry for square markers and retain independent history

cases.name: Guide label offsets
cases.given: Linear and angular annotations with centered or moved labels
cases.when: Drag/nudge/reset labels, copy/paste, save/load and export
cases.then: Only textOffset changes; undo/cancel restore it and automatic crops include remote labels

cases.name: Fixed SVG details and compound children
cases.given: Authored bounds, fixed IDs and fixedSize compound children
cases.when: Scale nonuniformly above/below nominal size, flip, decompose and export
cases.then: Retain midpoint anchors/world sizes, shrink uniformly below nominal and use actual child collision/contact geometry

cases.name: Optimized PNG
cases.given: PNG-compatible export controls and an existing destination file
cases.when: Select Optimized PNG, export with alpha/print density, switch modes and simulate encoder failure
cases.then: Use PNG preview/scale and .png, preserve density/alpha through quantization, undo selector changes and preserve destination on error

cases.name: Oversized bounded previews
cases.given: Output dimensions exceed preview raster budgets
cases.when: Navigate PNG/SVG preview, vary zoom/crop and switch solid objects
cases.then: Retain budgeted overview/detail rasters and doorway clipping while enforcing independent file limits

cases.name: Locate and resolve missing assets
cases.given: A recovered project with missing standalone or compound furnishings
cases.when: Click report entries, edit/delete/undo while report remains open and save/reopen
cases.then: Show original missing names/error artwork, frame surrounding context, refresh modeless list and clear recovery-copy state after saving

cases.name: Centered opening endpoint resize
cases.given: Door or window supported by a wall
cases.when: Shift-drag an endpoint, cancel and commit
cases.then: Move the opposite endpoint equally in reverse without extrusion; supporting-wall constraints remain active

cases.name: Help viewer input and layout
cases.given: Modeless Help window showing a long page
cases.when: Navigate history with icon/device commands, wheel over margins, autoscroll and inspect inline code
cases.then: Use separate window and reading-column backgrounds, window-edge scrollbar, current typography and isolated navigation

cases.name: Guide session-selection recovery
cases.given: A persisted scene and UI selection identifying guide middle/label targets
cases.when: Restore the app session and validate malformed object/index combinations
cases.then: Preserve valid guide selections without changing geometry and reject incompatible handles before applying the scene

cases.name: Measurement split-selector composition
cases.given: Settings Measurements page at different widths
cases.when: Inspect label/selector/reset positions and use labels, track and wheel
cases.then: Keep two distinct columns, align discrete choices to their vertical detents, map two-position indices to modes 0/2 and retain separate visibility controls

cases.name: Wall Tool specialized layout
cases.given: Build sidebar at narrow and wide widths
cases.when: Inspect shape choices/divider/presets/material and change width or material
cases.then: Keep shape column separate from width and material, align artwork/captions to preset travel, configure new walls independently of selected walls and wrap object palettes

cases.name: Export specialized composition
cases.given: Export at standard and wide sidebar widths
cases.when: Scroll all sections and switch PNG, SVG and Optimized PNG between Digital and Architectural
cases.then: Keep header and action pinned, preserve section/amount-row composition and show only format-appropriate resolution, PPI and Composite controls

cases.name: Object Properties specialized composition
cases.given: Furnishing, control-point and label selections
cases.when: Inspect paired Position and Size rows, change selection and edit properties
cases.then: Preserve object identity, equal paired fields, centered link, per-type defaults, conditional controls and proportional labels without an unlink option

cases.name: Reference Image settings composition and restoration
cases.given: A loaded visible reference image and a previous properties selection
cases.when: Enter image settings, transform or edit fields, then cancel or leave
cases.then: Use the replacement heading, path/opacity/paired properties layout, exclusive transforms and previous properties-state restoration

cases.name: Reference calibration workflow and prompt
cases.given: Active visible reference image
cases.when: Place points by click or drag, adjust with Ctrl snapping, confirm with one-use units or cancel
cases.then: Retain standard hints, hover/cursors and guides, settings-style distance and right-anchored units; scale about the first point only on valid confirmation

cases.name: Consistent furnishing asset status and Null colors
cases.given: Missing top-level assets, nested missing children, missing images, recovered fallback artwork and a built-in north arrow
cases.when: Open or restore, inspect properties, copy/duplicate and render PNG/SVG repeatedly
cases.then: Retain original keys, report real asset faults consistently, exclude built-ins, keep exports quiet and all Null foreground error-colored even when selected

cases.name: Exact coincident furnishing warnings
cases.given: Visible furnishings with the same original definition, oriented endpoints, width and flips
cases.when: Overlap exactly, reorder paint layers, hide, move apart and undo
cases.then: Keep the rear copy normal, tint front copies with the advisory warning role and retain valid placement and clipboard behavior

cases.name: Omit editor warnings and Null from exported artwork
cases.given: Coincident furnishings, contained walls, Null placeholders and healthy compound siblings
cases.when: Render PNG/SVG and bounded overview/detail snapshots
cases.then: Match the cleaned scene, retain healthy compound children and leave editor records and undo state unchanged

cases.name: Accurate editing-canvas pan preparation reuse
cases.given: Stable furnishing and wall geometry at different display scales
cases.when: Pan with whole-device-pixel and fractional motion, then change geometry, visibility or paint layers
cases.then: Reuse camera-independent furnishing extents and cull whole wall contours without changing camera motion, joins, clipping or cached/direct pixels

cases.name: Pan input and repaint pacing
cases.given: A screen refresh rate and a burst of middle-drag mouse inputs
cases.when: Deliver fractional moves, delay a frame deadline, release or interrupt the drag
cases.then: Update camera coordinates immediately, combine repaint requests at refresh-based deadlines, skip obsolete slots and stop all pending pan ticks on exit

cases.name: Held drag and box selection edge panning
cases.given: An active canvas transform, box selection, wall draw, reference/calibration point drag or catalogue placement
cases.when: Hold the pointer near or beyond a visible canvas edge, then return inside, release, cancel or deactivate
cases.then: Pan continuously with equal axial and diagonal speed, retain world anchors and existing modifiers including box selection add/remove, stop immediately on exit, and retain one edit per geometry gesture without edits for selection

cases.name: Inspect current scene problems
cases.given: An open plan with missing assets and current geometry or placement problems
cases.when: Run Check for Problems, locate, repair or delete targets and undo changes while the window remains open
cases.then: Keep a live modeless list, highlight all affected objects without selecting them all, share recovery repair proposals, preserve undo and exclude inspection highlights from exports

cases.name: Potential wall issues and safe repairs
cases.given: Walls nearly aligned to axes or right angles, endpoints just off grid and nearby disconnected endpoints
cases.when: Inspect the separate Potential issues section, navigate and auto-repair suggestions
cases.then: Keep grid targets stable during navigation, use warning highlights and reviewable corrections, preserve junctions/openings and undo, and roll back repairs introducing hard validation errors

cases.name: Ignore intentional potential issues
cases.given: A plan with intentional geometry reported under Potential issues
cases.when: Ignore suggestions, save/reopen and change or restore their geometry
cases.then: Keep unchanged geometry-specific dismissals with the plan, retain hard problems, restore warnings for changed geometry and provide Restore ignored

cases.name: Boundary line annotations
cases.given: A boundary line with two endpoints
cases.when: Place, select, edit, persist and export the annotation
cases.then: Share measurement-guide editing, render a readable dash-dot stroke, display length only while selected and export the line without dimension text
